boundaries.name: first-port-finding-is-not-public-authority
boundaries.rule: The cited DIM-01 deep-draft channel finding, gap CLI output, and portfolio summaries are research-lab evidence only. They do not authorize dredging design, terminal lease advice, NEPA or permitting evidence, funding direction, port-authority position, agency endorsement, carrier endorsement, or IMO endorsement. Public promotion requires a named release artifact, visible unassessed dimensions, cited corpus/source basis, declared scale, reproducible run, and full role review.
